audience: sales and marketing teams that send personalized videos to prospects with Sendspark

useCases.title: Review campaigns and their prospects
useCases.text: List the Dynamic Video campaigns of a workspace. Read one campaign and the video status of one prospect.

useCases.title: Check whether a video has a transcript
useCases.text: Check if a campaign video has a transcript. Read it as JSON, WebVTT or SubRip subtitles once it is ready.

useCases.title: Create a new campaign
useCases.text: Create a new, empty Dynamic Video campaign with a name. Add prospects to it afterwards.

useCases.title: Add a prospect and generate its video
useCases.text: Add one prospect to a campaign and generate the personalized video. Paid video credits are used only if you agree to the charge.

useCases.title: Review the webhooks of a workspace
useCases.text: List the webhooks that Sendspark calls on video events, and read one webhook.
